extracted.intended_audience: authors and writers who want to use TikTok/BookTok to promote books or engage readers
extracted.subtask_description: Advice and practical criteria for authors (and interested readers) creating BookTok/TikTok content to promote books, build readership, and engage the BookTok community. Covers content strategy, format choices, community norms, and platform-specific tactics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make content you love / get inspiration from others
rubrics_metrics.description: The best way to get started is to simply get inspired by other writers and readers on BookTok and make content that you love.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Study how other creators promote their books and adapt techniques you enjoy. Authentic enthusiasm drives much of BookTok's appeal: creators who started for fun can accidentally influence large audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Have a clear notion of your goals before posting
rubrics_metrics.description: Have a clear notion of what you’re trying to accomplish on the app before you post.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Decide whether your priority is building community, increasing sales, growing visibility, or sharing craft tips — this will shape tone and format. Blair: understand differences between reader and author spaces before posting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Understand and respect reader vs. author spaces
rubrics_metrics.description: Spend the time necessary to understand the differences between reader and author spaces, and don’t infringe on reader-only discourse.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Learn community norms and boundaries; avoid appropriating or disrupting reader conversations. Participation that disregards established community dynamics can perform poorly or provoke backlash.

rubrics_metrics.name: Build genuine community; avoid purely promotional content
rubrics_metrics.description: Only join if you’re wanting to post consistently and engage with readers in a much more personal way than ever before. Join to build a genuine community with your readership and not just promote your books — those videos don’t often do well, anyway.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize engagement (comments, responses, conversation) and relationship-building over one-way marketing. Promotion-only posts tend to underperform relative to authentic interaction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Be prepared to get personal / show behind-the-scenes
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors should prepare to get personal and keep an intimate approach when making content, like showing behind-the-scenes moments of the writing process to forge a connection.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Personal, process-oriented content helps readers relate to the author and fosters loyalty; be willing to share small, candid moments rather than only polished promotional material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Balance planned content with spontaneous/trending posts
rubrics_metrics.description: Being a BookToker involves balancing pre-planned videos with of-the-moment creations: plan reviews and recommendations but sometimes film on the spot for trending sounds/ideas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Have a content plan for staples (reviews, recommendations) but leave room to capitalize on trends and sounds that arise in your For You feed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Be selective about what you promote
rubrics_metrics.description: Be choosy about what books make the cut to be promoted on your account — I don’t post about every book that I read, and that’s because I like to post about books that are objectively good, my audience would like, and nothing that’s harmful.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Curate recommendations to fit your brand and audience; selectivity improves credibility and prevents audience fatigue.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use platform-specific techniques: quotes, sounds, multimedia staging
rubrics_metrics.description: Trending content styles include pulling a powerful quote from a book and showcasing it on screen, using trending sounds, and multimedia approaches (e.g., play a clip on a laptop, then close it and bring the book on screen).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hooks like on-screen quotes, well-timed audio, and creative visual transitions help catch viewers quickly in TikTok’s short format. Experiment with staging to capture a book's energy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Employ varied content types (reviews, slideshows, tours, roundups)
rubrics_metrics.description: BookTok content can include short and long book reviews, quick-picture slideshows set to music, mini tours of bookstores, thematic book roundups, and creative reminders about libraries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mix formats to keep your feed fresh and to appeal to different viewer preferences — from quick hooks to slightly longer recommendations or themed lists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Leverage TikTok’s short format and algorithm
rubrics_metrics.description: TikTok’s bite-sized videos and ultra-personalized algorithm can match content to viewers quickly; even one well-timed video can go viral and cause big sales bumps.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Craft concise, attention-grabbing openings (e.g., a pulled quote or a direct imperative). Use hashtags like #BookTok and trust algorithmic discovery; a single viral recommendation can drive books onto bestseller lists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tailor content to audience demographics and platform trends
rubrics_metrics.description: BookTok has a strong Gen Z foothold but includes diverse ages; current trends show emphasis on short books and novellas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be aware of who is active on BookTok and which book types are trending; adjusting recommendations (e.g., spotlighting novellas) can align with user behavior and tend to perform well.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prioritize authenticity and avoid harmful material
rubrics_metrics.description: Post about books that are 'objectively good' for your audience and 'nothing that’s harmful.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain ethical awareness about content you promote; harmful or insensitive recommendations can damage reputation and community standing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adapt ideas from your For You page into book-related content
rubrics_metrics.description: When you see stuff on your For You page, think: ‘How can I make this book-related?’ — use sounds and concepts from trending videos to generate book content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Borrow trending formats and repurpose them to highlight books or writing in ways that feel native to the platform, increasing shareability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expect variable scale and potential overwhelm from virality
rubrics_metrics.description: Viral moments can be shocking and overwhelming (e.g., sudden sales spikes), and creators should be prepared for emotional and logistical effects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan for rapid audience growth (engagement management, supply of books, PR) and be mindful of personal bandwidth when a post unexpectedly goes viral.
